Cohere Health is seeking a Software Engineer I to design, develop, test, and support healthcare integration systems connecting the company with providers, payers, delegated entities, and third-party platforms. The role contributes to an enterprise integration platform, including APIs, distributed systems, cloud delivery, testing, security, and production support.
Software
Healthcare
SaaS
Consumer Software
Health Care
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Software Development: Design, develop, test, and maintain reliable and scalable services that support critical business workflows and enterprise integrations
Integration Solutions: Develop and maintain secure integrations with internal and external platforms, partners, and third-party systems
API Development: Build and support APIs and work with external APIs, data exchange protocols, and common integration patterns
Distributed Systems: Work with event-driven architectures, asynchronous messaging, and distributed systems to support reliable and scalable processing
Cloud & Automation: Contribute to cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and software delivery practices
Quality Engineering: Develop automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests and contribute to improving the team's testing frameworks and practices
Operational Excellence: Use monitoring, logging, metrics, and observability tools to troubleshoot issues and improve system reliability and performance
Production Support: Troubleshoot and resolve integration and production issues and participate in on-call and operational support activities as needed
Security: Implement secure integrations using authentication, authorization, access control, and API security best practices
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with product, operations, QA, infrastructure, and other engineering teams to deliver integration solutions
Agile Delivery: Participate in technical discussions, planning, backlog refinement, code reviews, and delivery activities within an agile development environment
Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to technical documentation and share knowledge and best practices across the team
Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve code quality, system reliability, engineering processes, and operational efficiency

Required
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering or related field; or equivalent experience
1-2 years of experience in software development building and supporting applications or services
Experience with at least one modern programming language such as Java, Python, or similar
Hands-on experience with REST APIs, HTTP, JSON, and common integration patterns
Experience writing unit and/or integration tests
Familiarity with relational and/or non-relational databases and data modeling
Understanding of software development practices, version control, and CI/CD
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
Ability to work collaboratively with engineers and cross-functional teams
Understanding of authentication, authorization, and secure API design
Experience building and supporting integrations with external APIs or third-party systems
Experience with event-driven architecture, asynchronous messaging, or distributed systems
Experience with automated integration or end-to-end testing frameworks
Experience with cloud platforms, Infrastructure as Code, or CI/CD pipeline design
Experience with observability, monitoring, logging, and production troubleshooting
Experience in healthcare technology, health plan operations, or prior authorization systems
Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as FHIR or other healthcare data exchange protocols
